Name: Hobbit Holes Expanded
Author: Mswati
Description:
Replaces farmhouse and cabins with hobbit holes.
Replaces Krobus with Smeagol.
Replaces Dwarf with Gimli.
Replaces Wizard with Gandalf.  [b][color=#ff0000]Warning! [/color][/b]Renaming Wizard to Gandalf breaks SVE compatibility - you can edit the name back with config file if needed.[color=#ff0000]
[/color][b][color=#ff0000]
